summary: Dead code removal is complete and correct. All DevserverManager source code, tests, documentation, and constants fully removed with no dangling references. 17 verification tests added to prevent regressions.
analysis:
Reviewed the full implementation across 3 producers (coder, documenter, tester) totaling ~3100 lines removed and 272 lines of verification tests added.

**Coder (commit 9a8cf2fc84):**
7 source files modified/deleted. (1) orchestrator/api.py: checks_bp import and registration removed from both try/except blocks — clean. (2) orchestrator/devserver.py (1028 lines): deleted entirely. (3) orchestrator/routes/checks.py (272 lines): deleted entirely. (4) orchestrator/routes/phases.py: teardown_devserver import and all 3 call sites removed — surrounding code flows naturally. (5) shared/egg_config/constants.py: 5 constants + __all__ entries removed. (6) shared/egg_contracts/__init__.py: .deployment import block + __all__ entries removed. (7) shared/egg_contracts/deployment.py (227 lines): deleted entirely. Grep verification confirms zero remaining references across the codebase.

**Documenter (commit 4225973754):**
5 documentation files updated. Removed DevserverManager references from: docs/architecture/README.md, docs/architecture/orchestrator.md (API endpoints + 80-line section), docs/development/STRUCTURE.md, docs/guides/sdlc-pipeline.md (check table + 54-line section), orchestrator/README.md. All doc references eliminated.

**Tester (commit c3d3363dcb):**
Deleted 4 orphaned test files (1547 lines) that imported from removed modules. Added 17 verification tests in tests/config/test_devserver_removal.py using AST-based import scanning. Updated tests/config/test_ci_config.py comment. 9816 tests pass, 1 pre-existing failure unrelated to changes.

**Security**: No concerns — pure deletion of dead code.
**Correctness**: All references eliminated, no broken imports remain.
**Robustness**: Verification tests guard against accidental reintroduction.
suggestions: None. The implementation is clean and well-scoped.
